title: Semantic Audio Taxonomy & Availability Resolver
start_authority: Owner Continue on 2026-08-26 America/Chicago after fresh verification of AIOC main d7b622bc28c56c32e529edcb355345fb4f4d8427 and application main e8c0161e325a9d59b061a61c47d9b620a492cb03, re-reading the AAI program/backlog, AAI-05 selection checkpoint and completed AAI-01 through AAI-04 evidence, then resolving the bounded provider-neutral semantic taxonomy/availability, independent rights/capability/provenance, persistence and validation contract before implementation branch creation.
objective: Define and prove a provider-neutral semantic audio taxonomy and deterministic availability resolver over completed AAI-02 AudioIntent/AudioAsset/AudioCue/AudioSource identities, AAI-03 capability evidence and AAI-04 nonblocking playback outcomes. The resolver may select only an existing AAI-02 asset identity after deterministic semantic matching and independent fail-closed rights/capability/runtime-availability checks; it never rewrites provider-native or canonical identities, silently prefers a provider, performs provider calls, acquires content, mutates gameplay owners or makes audio gameplay truth.

taxonomy.normalization_rule: Semantic terms are derived only from existing AAI-02 AudioIntent.semanticPath segments, AudioIntent.tags and AudioAsset.semanticTags. Terms are normalized by trim + lowercase, must match [a-z0-9-]+, are de-duplicated and sorted for deterministic comparison. AAI-05 does not rewrite AAI-02 semanticPath, tags, provider IDs, asset IDs or provider-reference IDs.
taxonomy.match_rule: An asset is semantically compatible only when every normalized intent tag is present in the normalized asset semanticTags. Extra asset tags are permitted. Exact semantic-path segment coverage contributes deterministic specificity but never overrides missing required intent tags.
taxonomy.ranking_rule: Eligible candidates rank by descending required-tag coverage, descending exact path-segment coverage, then stable assetId ascending. Provider identity is never a ranking signal and no provider/catalog is canonical.
taxonomy.unknown_rule: Missing intent, empty/invalid normalized intent terms, missing asset semantic tags or malformed semantic evidence fail closed as semantic-unknown/incompatible and cannot be selected.

availability.rights_rule: Asset and source AAI-02 play rights must both be exactly allowed before an audible candidate may be available. denied, unknown and not-applicable fail closed. Semantic compatibility never grants rights.
availability.capability_rule: Provider-controlled/external candidates consume completed AAI-03 negotiation for playback-control or one-shot-control as applicable. Only selectable AAI-03 outcomes may be available; unsupported, undocumented, unknown, planned, provider-contact-required and not-applicable evidence fail closed. A manual-external-reference outcome remains available-manual-external and is never silently automated.
availability.local_rule: User-owned local candidates require usable AAI-03 local-file-access plus an explicit caller-supplied runtime media probe state supported. unsupported/unknown runtime probes fail closed and do not rewrite AAI-03 evidence.
availability.reference_rule: Candidate asset/source/provider-reference identities must resolve through AAI-02 exactly; missing references fail closed. Provider-specific live catalog search is not performed.
availability.independence_rule: Semantic compatibility, AAI-02 provenance/rights, AAI-03 capability and runtime availability are recorded as independent evidence dimensions. Passing one cannot upgrade another.

cue_and_playback.rule: AAI-05 resolves only AAI-02 unresolved cues that carry an existing intentId. AAI-02 manual-reference cues remain manual and explicit; silent cues remain silent. AAI-05 emits a resolver receipt containing selected existing assetId or null. It does not mutate the cue. A selected asset may be handed to completed AAI-04 planning as caller input, preserving AAI-04 controlled/manual/silent/unavailable/degraded nonblocking behavior.

receipts.rule: Deterministic receipts contain cue/intent IDs, normalized semantic terms, candidate asset/source IDs, semantic evidence, AAI-02 play-right states, AAI-03 capability/negotiation evidence, explicit runtime probe when relevant, availability state, stable ranking data and selected assetId or null. Wall clock, machine paths, credentials, network state, live provider responses and platform identity are excluded.

identity_and_owners.rule: AAI-02 provider/source/asset/reference/intent/cue identities are consumed, never rewritten. World/Event/Scene/Combat/Action/Visibility/D29 owners remain canonical. Resolver output is presentation/support state only and cannot create gameplay truth or mutate owner records.

persistence.result: No durable persistence is required for AAI-05. Taxonomy projections, candidate evaluations and resolver receipts are deterministic derived/runtime values over existing AAI-02/03 evidence and caller runtime probes. No new canonical stored identity or lifecycle record is required; migration 0022 remains unreserved.

validation_contract.focused: Prove deterministic provider-neutral taxonomy normalization/matching/ranking; semantic/rights/capability/runtime evidence independence; fail-closed unknown/denied/unavailable/incompatible candidates; preservation of manual/silent cues and AAI-04 nonblocking outcomes; no provider preference, calls, content acquisition, owner mutation or durable persistence.
validation_contract.predecessors: Run AAI-04, AAI-03, AAI-02 and AAI-01 verifiers plus MIB-11/D18 World-owner regression on both required platforms.
validation_contract.workflow: Register AAI-05 in canonical Repository Health path coverage and self-hosted Validation Core discovery without provider/network dependencies.
validation_contract.final_gate: Exact candidate head must pass Repository Health, self-hosted Linux and Windows AAI-05 Validation Core, deterministic cross-platform comparison and declared AAI-04/03/02/01/World-owner regressions before merge.

preserved_boundaries: AAI-01 through AAI-04 remain completed_verified with no further implementation authority
AAI-05 authority is limited to provider-neutral semantic taxonomy/availability resolver logic, deterministic evidence, governed documentation, focused regression/verifier and Validation Core wiring
semantic compatibility, AAI-02 rights/provenance, AAI-03 capability and runtime availability remain independent and fail closed
AAI-02 provider/source/asset/reference/intent/cue identities remain binding inputs and cannot be rewritten
AAI-04 playback/layer/mixer outcomes and nonblocking behavior remain binding predecessor behavior
no provider/catalog is canonical and provider identity cannot be used as an implicit ranking preference
manual and silent cues remain explicit; unsupported operations cannot be emulated by scraping, reverse engineering or prohibited copying
AAI-06 provider-specific live adapters remain unauthorized
no provider authentication/live catalog/provider calls/acquisition/download/copying/scraping/payment, tester distribution, release/deployment or real-money activation
